name: 358-ball
notes: #358 B2.b ball: three kids in a triangle toss a big drawn ball (View/Beats/KidPlay.cs BallGame). Two-handed underhand toss (peg dolls have no legs): squash and arms back, swing through with a hop, release (the Contact); the ball flies on a kit arc from the thrower's hands to the catcher's arms; the catcher lifts its arms as it comes, catches (squash, a step back), holds it, turns to the next one. One throw in four lands past the catcher, bounces twice and rolls to a stop; the nearest kid runs, bends, picks it up, runs back. Every 6-9 throws the holder holds the ball up high (the end beat). AnimLab: cheat 'Kids play: ball'.
